follow-up time: not specified, but measurement taken after delivery
cohort: Pregnant women (17-43 years) over 37 weeks of pregnancy
finding: Maternal serum IL-6 levels and maternal colostrum melatonin levels were significantly higher in patients who delivered vaginally than in patients who delivered by Cesarean section.
mod_finding: The study found that maternal serum IL-6 levels were significantly higher in patients who delivered vaginally than in patients who delivered by cesarean section.
